verdict.rationale: Vue's reactivity system (ref/reactive) can technically be used to build a global store without extra packages, and vue-docs-4 gestures at Vue's built-in reactive system, but the evidence pack's actual documented state-management story points to Pinia (vue-docs-8) — a separate installable library — as the recommended solution, and community comments (vue-comm-9, vue-comm-13) also frame Vuex/Pinia as the official 'third-party' add-ons rather than built-in primitives. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of reactive()/ref() as a supported global-state pattern, and confirmation that Vue discourages/avoids Pinia for simple global state cases.
